summary: QuickEntryPlacing facilitates the creation and submission of Placement Requests (PRs) for educational placements, supporting both single and group placements, and managing associated metadata, validations, actors, and workflows.
purpose: To provide a guided workflow for quickly entering Placement Requests, including assignment of students, agency/site/service/destination selection, request code selection, scheduling (dates, times, shifts), and all necessary validation before submission to the Outbox or Receiving Agency.

workflows.name: Placement Request Creation and Submission
steps: Initialize dropdowns for agencies, departments, programs, sites, services, destinations, courses, placement coordinators, instructors, request codes.
Populate session variables for placing and receiving context (agency, department, program, site, service, destination).
Collect student assignments via command buttons (cmdAdd, cmdClear), update hidden fields.
Present request code options depending on program, hide if not used.
Enter and validate metadata: Project Title, Destination Details, Group Size, Request Codes, Comments, Alerts.
Schedule placement: input/validation for Start Date, End Date, Reply By Date.
Configure shifts/times: choose shift code or manually input start/end times, select applicable days, durations, shift length, and various flags.
Validate all fields: program, site/service, course, program year, placement coordinator, dates, times, group sizes, durations, request codes.
Handle NIS/IRP participation and PA Breaks flags based on context.
On successful validation, call DataLayer.QuickEntry.QESCreatePARequest with all parameters.
If creation is successful: display confirmation including reference number, and handle printing as needed.

business_rules: Program, site/service, course, and placement coordinator are required.
Start and end dates are required and must be valid; end date must be after start date.
Reply by date must be valid, can be blank, but if present must be before start date.
Duration (hours) is required and must be a positive number.
Shifts and shift length must be numeric if provided.
Group size must be numeric and > 0 if entered; must be >= student count for group placements.
Validation of start/end times (24-hour format) and shift code if used.
If group size is 1, placement type isn't Group, and exactly one student assigned, group size reset to blank (interpreted as Enrollment PR).
Request codes must be valid and present for programs using requests.
Comments and alerts are optional but subject to visibility controls.
NIS/IRP participation and PA breaks are controlled by program and user context.
validations: Required fields: program, site, service, course, program year, placement coordinator.
Duration, shift length, group size numeric validation.
Times validated for 24-hour format and for shift code if selected.
Group size validation against student count and course type.
If start/end times present without shift length, auto-calculate shift length.
If duration shifts and shift length valid but duration blank, auto-calculate duration.
calculations: Shift length = endTime - startTime (in hours), adjust for overnight if endTime < startTime.
Duration hours = durationShifts * shiftLength, auto-calculated if possible.
Group size recalculated for single student, non-group placements.
conditions: If department uses shift codes, show shift code field; otherwise show start/end time fields.
If program uses requests, show request code selector; hide otherwise.
Show NIS/IRP and PA Breaks flags based on user/program context.
Validation errors stop workflow and show error panel.
If no service or destination contact, show edit fields; otherwise show formatted contact info.
system_behavior: Page loads and initializes controls, session values, and dropdowns.
Client-side JavaScript updates fields, hidden values for students, durations, and validation.
On submit, server validates and creates Placement Request, then updates UI for confirmation.
Handles reset (“lbReset”) to clear all fields to default values.
dependencies: Dropdowns depend on UserSession and selected values.
Course info and request codes depend on program/department.
NIS/IRP and PA Breaks depend on program/user/system configuration.
Validation messages depend on resource localization.
exceptions: Validation errors for required fields, date formats, group sizes, durations, shifts, times.
No assigned students or improper group sizes block submission.
Invalid start/end time or shift/time mismatch triggers error.
Reply by date after start date triggers error.
